highlights.title: CS646 Sanctum 3D Cryptographic Memory Palace
highlights.subtitle: Gamified Distributed Ledger & Cryptographic Verification Environment
highlights.description: Architected an interactive 3D browser-based learning world visualizing abstract blockchain and cryptocurrency mechanisms. Features 5 distinct districts (Consensus, Cryptography, Money Exchange, Network, Storage), procedural hover vehicle traversal, and real-time SHA-256 block hashing demonstrations.

highlights.title: MaqkrsTutor2 (Local AI Privacy-Preserving Study Assistant)
highlights.subtitle: Native macOS/iOS Local Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Local RAG)
highlights.description: Engineered a native Apple Silicon assistant that indexes technical course documents, PDFs, and source code for grounded question answering with 0 network egress. Protects institutional and student data through 100% on-device inference using quantized foundation models.

highlights.title: AdaptivePrep & AdaptiveHS Learning Platform
highlights.subtitle: K-12 Homeschool Learning Management System & Curriculum Portal
highlights.description: Developed a full-stack homeschool platform aligned with Georgia Standards of Excellence (GSE). Implemented role-based authentication separating Parent oversight, Student modules, and Educator tools with adaptive question generation and rubric scoring.

highlights.title: MaQkRs OS Command Center & Operational Planner
highlights.subtitle: Unified Executive Business Dashboard & Multi-Agent Operations Hub
highlights.description: Engineered an operational command center providing real-time telemetry across multi-agent workflows, business financials, project sprint schedules, and system health monitors with responsive dark-mode cyber styling.
